item.title: VoiceInk 2.27 (b5d1be9)
item.description:
VoiceInk 2.27 (b5d1be9)

  • Release version 2.27 (b5d1be9a)
  • Add Scribe V3 streaming support (27130058)
  • Track dashboard window visibility with an AppKit view (7e28c013)
  • Log the status when a Keychain presence check fails (1a730286)
  • Use occlusion state for the dashboard visibility gate (54f32714)
  • Cache only definite Keychain presence answers (e737bf3c)
  • Skip the dashboard recent query while the window is hidden (c5996972)
  • Stop re-evaluating every scene on engine updates (082d115b)
  • Cache API key presence checks (077e51df)
  • Make ScreenSleepPreventer synchronous and main-actor isolated (c9e2544d)
  • Revert "Address Opus code review: add playbackSessionID guards around async hardware start suspension points in Recorder.swift" (f623c183)
  • Address Opus code review: add playbackSessionID guards around async hardware start suspension points in Recorder.swift (306a1407)
  • Address slow-model code review: unconditionally reset assertionID on release attempt to prevent permanent lockout (be0b29e3)
  • Address code review feedback: call startPreventingSleep before hardware setup and retain assertionID on release failure (937295e5)
  • Prevent display sleep and screen saver during active dictation/recording (dfa6a098)
